# Monk

<Vocation
  primaryAbility="Dexterity and Wisdom"
  hitDie="d8 per Monk level"
  saves="Strength and Dexterity"
  skills="Choose 2: Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Religion, or Stealth"
  trades="Choose one [Trade](/en/library/items/tools) (any artisan trade or [Music](/en/library/items/tools/music))"
  weapons="Simple weapons and Martial weapons with the Light property"
  armor="None"
  equipment="Spear, 5 Daggers, a kit for your chosen [Trade](/en/library/items/tools), Explorer's Pack, 11 GP — or 50 GP">

## Vocation Features

<Feature level="1">

#### Martial Arts

Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use your
unarmed strike and Monk weapons.

- **Bonus Unarmed Strike**: Make an Unarmed Strike as a **Minor Action**.
- **Martial Arts Die**: Use the die shown in the Monk table for your unarmed strikes.

</Feature>

<Feature level="2" cost="1 Minor Action">

#### Monk's Focus

Your focus and martial training allow you to harness a well of extraordinary
energy within yourself.

</Feature>

<Feature level="5">

#### Extra Attack

You may attack **twice** instead of once when you take the **Attack action**.

</Feature>

</Vocation>
